python-git-starter.title: FDE Module 2 · Starter kit: Python and Git setup

production-python-class5.summary: Write a contract for each record, log every step, produce a run report, check AI replies and protect a small web screen with a password.

production-python-class8.title: Production Python 8 · Profiling, generators and rate caps
production-python-class8.summary: Measure and profile the workbench, replace in-memory lists with generators, cap model calls and fix a stale-cache bug with a safer key.

DSML-Python-1.title: DSML Python 1 · Data types, variables and I/O

DSML-Python-7.title: DSML Python 7 · File handling and error handling
DSML-Python-7.summary: Read and write text and CSV files with the with statement, pick file modes, and catch and raise exceptions while processing transactions.

AI-infused-session.title: AI-Infused Learning · Intro to LLMs and the AI landscape

scaler-claude-curriculum.title: Claude Curriculum Explorer · Scaler

AI-beginners-class8.title: AI Beginners 8 · AI for content creation
AI-beginners-class8.summary: Turn one brief into a deck, documents and a social visual with Gamma, Claude or ChatGPT, and Canva, then judge the output against a clear structure.

AI-beginners-class9.title: AI Beginners 9 · Multimodal GenAI: images, video, voice

AI-beginners-class5.title: AI Beginners 5 · Retrieval-augmented generation

class-3-AI-engg.title: AI Engineering 3 · RAG: give your AI its own library

AI-beginners-class6.title: AI Beginners 6 · Web-grounded research and citations

your-first-agent.title: Agents on AWS 1 · Your first AI agent

AI-beginners-class11.title: AI Beginners 11 · Automating with n8n

AI-beginners-class20.summary: Choose between chatbot, workflow and agent, design fallbacks and human review, test consistency with gold answers, and watch a live dashboard.

DSML-SL-8.title: DSML Supervised 8 · XGBoost, LightGBM and ensembles
DSML-SL-8.summary: Tune a real XGBoost model, learn its hyperparameters and regularisation, and see how other ensemble families compare.

DSML-SL-9.title: DSML Supervised 9 · Naive Bayes for spam filtering
DSML-SL-9.summary: Build a word-counting spam filter from Bayes' theorem. Clean the text and split the data before training the model.

DSML-SL-10.title: DSML Supervised 10 · Naive Bayes: smoothing and imbalance
DSML-SL-10.summary: Tune the Laplace smoothing alpha, handle class imbalance, avoid numerical underflow, and explain which words drove each prediction.

DSML-SL-11.title: DSML Supervised 11 · SVM: the maximum margin
DSML-SL-11.summary: Find the widest safe boundary with a support vector machine. Use hard and soft margins and the C hyperparameter on an SMS fraud filter.

DSML-SL-12.title: DSML Supervised 12 · SVM: dual form and kernels
DSML-SL-12.summary: Work through the dual formulation and kernel trick, then use polynomial and RBF kernels to separate data no straight line can split.

Intro-to-clustering-and-K-means.title: Clustering · Intro to clustering and K-means
Intro-to-clustering-and-K-means.summary: Group unlabelled customers by similarity and build a K-Means segmentation engine from first principles. Then watch the algorithm converge.

K-means-and-K-means-Clustering.title: Clustering · K-means limits and K-means++
K-means-and-K-means-Clustering.summary: Find where K-means breaks on cluster shape and initialisation. Build K-means++ from scratch and choose K with the elbow method.

Hierarchical-Clustering.title: Clustering · Hierarchical clustering and dendrograms
Hierarchical-Clustering.summary: Build agglomerative clusters step by step, compare linkage criteria, and read a dendrogram to choose where to cut.

DBSCAN.title: Clustering · DBSCAN density-based clustering
DBSCAN.summary: Find clusters of any shape by tuning eps and MinPts. Classify core, border and noise points, and flag unusual customers.

Gaussian-Mixture-Models-.title: Clustering · Gaussian mixture models with EM
Gaussian-Mixture-Models-.summary: Replace hard clusters with soft, probabilistic memberships. Fit Gaussians with Expectation-Maximisation and compare them with hierarchical clustering.

Principal-Component-Analysis.title: Dimensionality reduction · PCA for a wall-screen view
Principal-Component-Analysis.summary: Compress thirty columns into two components for a visual map. Learn when to select features versus combine them, and why dimensions matter.

t-SNE-and-UMAP.title: Dimensionality reduction · t-SNE and UMAP
t-SNE-and-UMAP.summary: See where PCA fails on the Swiss roll, learn how t-SNE turns distances into probabilities, and compare it with UMAP for embeddings.

Anomaly-Detection.title: Anomaly detection · Four unsupervised methods
Anomaly-Detection.summary: Compare four unsupervised detectors, from IQR fences to Elliptic Envelope, to flag unusual transactions in a card payments feed.

DSML-UnSL-1.title: DSML Unsupervised 1 · PCA for high-dimensional data
DSML-UnSL-1.summary: Shrink 784-pixel digit images by finding the directions of highest variance. This is the core idea behind PCA.

DSML-UnSL-2.title: DSML Unsupervised 2 · t-SNE for visualising data
DSML-UnSL-2.summary: See why PCA merges lookalike clusters. Learn how t-SNE converts distances into neighbour probabilities to separate them on a map.

DSML-UnSL-3.title: DSML Unsupervised 3 · t-SNE and UMAP in practice
DSML-UnSL-3.summary: Run baseline t-SNE on Fashion-MNIST and study its KL divergence. Then see how UMAP is faster and gives a reusable embedding.

DSML-UnSL-4.title: DSML Unsupervised 4 · K-Means and Lloyd's algorithm
DSML-UnSL-4.summary: Walk through the four steps of Lloyd's algorithm behind K-Means, watch the cost fall, and see how starting centroids matter.

DSML-UnSL-5.title: DSML Unsupervised 5 · K-Means++ and choosing K
DSML-UnSL-5.summary: Measure how K-Means results vary between runs, compare K from 1 to 10, and use K-Means++ seeding for stabler starting centres.

DSML-UnSL-6.title: DSML Unsupervised 6 · Gaussian mixture models
DSML-UnSL-6.summary: Model customers who belong to several segments with weighted Gaussians. Get soft memberships such as 55% in one segment, 45% in another.

DSML-UnSL-7.title: DSML Unsupervised 7 · Hierarchical clustering
DSML-UnSL-7.summary: Build agglomerative clusters from a proximity matrix. Read the dendrogram and choose K by cutting the tree at the right level.

DSML-UnSL-8.title: DSML Unsupervised 8 · DBSCAN for fraud review
DSML-UnSL-8.summary: Find dense clusters of any shape and flag accounts that belong to no group. The result is a ranked fraud review queue.

DSML-UnSL-9.title: DSML Unsupervised 9 · Anomaly detection methods
DSML-UnSL-9.summary: Compare simple rules with Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM and Local Outlier Factor. Spot masking and anomalies hidden in feature combinations.

DSML-UnSL-10.title: DSML Unsupervised 10 · Case study: framing and baseline
DSML-UnSL-10.summary: Frame a business decision as a cost-based ML problem. Audit the data, split it by time, and build a trustworthy baseline model.

DSML-UnSL-11.title: DSML Unsupervised 11 · Case study: error analysis and drift
DSML-UnSL-11.summary: Find where the model breaks using error analysis and unsupervised detectives. Then plan the sealed test, drift monitoring and deployment.

Recommender-Systems-1.title: Recommender Systems 1 · Apriori and association rules
Recommender-Systems-1.summary: Mine association rules with Apriori using support, confidence and lift. Then survey collaborative, content-based and factorization approaches.

Recommender-Systems-2.title: Recommender Systems 2 · Matrix factorization for DailyMart
Recommender-Systems-2.summary: Defend a matrix factorization recommender to skeptical leaders. Choose the number of factors d and combine several signals.

Recommender-Systems-3.title: Recommender Systems 3 · NMF segments and the Netflix Prize
Recommender-Systems-3.summary: See matrix factorization as a generalisation of clustering. Build explainable non-negative segments from three signals and reuse the vectors.

LightFM-extra-read.title: Recommender Systems · Extra: LightFM hybrids
LightFM-extra-read.summary: Compare two ways to build a hybrid recommender: LightFM with interactions and weights, or rank combination. Tune how much to trust each signal.

Timeseries-1.title: Time Series 1 · Missing values, anomalies and trend
Timeseries-1.summary: Clean Vastra Loop sales data by filling gaps and flagging anomalies. Then use moving averages, trend and seasonality to decompose a series.

Timeseries-2.title: Time Series 2 · Forecast baselines and MAPE
Timeseries-2.summary: Score forecasts with MAPE and split time series correctly. Beat naive baselines such as the mean and last value before trying models.

Timeseries-3.title: Time Series 3 · ARIMA, SARIMA and ACF/PACF
Timeseries-3.summary: Read ACF and PACF plots to choose AR, MA, ARMA and ARIMA orders. Then fit a SARIMA model to the sales data.

Timeseries-4.title: Time series 4 · SARIMAX and a 39-day forecast
Timeseries-4.summary: Decompose a series with weekly seasonality, add outside inputs with SARIMAX, run diagnostics, and forecast 39 unknown days.

Neural-Networks-1.title: Neural Networks 1 · Neurons and activation functions
Neural-Networks-1.summary: Build a single neuron from logistic regression and stack it into layers. See why activation functions let depth solve the two-spiral dataset.

Neural-Networks-2.title: Neural Networks 2 · Backpropagation and training
Neural-Networks-2.summary: Derive backpropagation for one layer and then a hidden layer. Study the loss landscape and assemble a two-layer network that trains.

Neural-Networks-3.title: Neural Networks 3 · Tensor shape, dtype, device and grad
Neural-Networks-3.summary: Diagnose the four tensor failure modes: shape, dtype, device and grad. Then build a batched linear layer by hand.

Neural-Networks-4.title: Neural Networks 4 · Devices and the training loop
Neural-Networks-4.summary: Move tensors between CPU and GPU, benchmark devices correctly, and write a training loop by hand before automating it with PyTorch tools.

Neural-Networks-5.title: Neural Networks 5 · Dropout, BatchNorm and evaluation
Neural-Networks-5.summary: Check whether a model truly generalises: spot overfitting, use dropout and batch normalization, and evaluate and save models correctly.

Neural-Networks-6.title: Neural Networks 6 · Weight initialization and optimizers
Neural-Networks-6.summary: See how starting weights affect training, then compare momentum, RMSprop and Adam, and how learning rate schedules change the path.

Neural-Networks-7.title: Neural Networks 7 · Autoencoders in PyTorch
Neural-Networks-7.summary: Build an autoencoder that compresses and rebuilds inputs through a bottleneck, then reuse its features for denoising and anomaly detection.

DSML-NN-1.title: Neural Networks 1 · Why a single neuron is not enough
DSML-NN-1.summary: Work through a battery-cell sorting case to see why standard classifiers fail on this data, and how one artificial neuron separates classes.

DSML-NN-2.title: Neural Networks 2 · Multi-class output and cross-entropy
DSML-NN-2.summary: Extend a neuron to several outputs with matrices, turn raw scores into probabilities with softmax, and measure error with cross-entropy.

DSML-NN-3.title: Neural Networks 3 · Layers, depth and the XOR problem
DSML-NN-3.summary: Stack layers into a hiring-pipeline network, see why one round cannot solve XOR, and trace how signals pass through a multi-layer network.

DSML-NN-4.title: Neural Networks 4 · Notation, softmax and training curves
DSML-NN-4.summary: Use compact notation to build a multi-layer network, train it end to end, and read training curves to tell learning from memorising.

DSML-NN-5.title: Neural Networks 5 · Training models in PyTorch
DSML-NN-5.summary: Prepare a workout dataset with encoding and scaling, then build, initialise and train a PyTorch classifier with a hand-written training loop.

DSML-NN-6.title: Neural Networks 6 · Backpropagation on a two-layer network
DSML-NN-6.summary: Derive the forward and backward passes of a two-layer network with the chain rule, then train it on a spiral dataset.

DSML-NN-7.title: Neural Networks 7 · Custom nn.Module and evaluation
DSML-NN-7.summary: Build branching models with a custom nn.Module, evaluate trained models correctly, and avoid the double-softmax bug that quietly skews predictions.

DSML-NN-8.title: Neural Networks 8 · Optimisers and learning rate decay
DSML-NN-8.summary: Compare mini-batch gradient descent with momentum, RMSprop and Adam on a delivery-routing problem, and see how batch size and decay change training.

DSML-NN-9.title: Neural Networks 9 · Fixing overfitting with regularisation
DSML-NN-9.summary: Diagnose a delivery-delay model that overfits, then compare L2 regularization, dropout, batch normalization and early stopping on the same data.

DSML-NN-10.title: Neural Networks 10 · Autoencoders for compression
DSML-NN-10.summary: Train autoencoders to compress and rebuild data, compare them with PCA, then use them for features, denoising and recommendations.

DSML-NN-11.title: Neural Networks 11 · Diagnosing and tuning deep models
DSML-NN-11.summary: Follow a structured method for a failing model: one change at a time, a baseline, gradient checking, error analysis and multi-task learning.

DSML-NN-12.title: Neural Networks 12 · Explaining models with LIME and SHAP
DSML-NN-12.summary: Explain individual predictions of a neural network with LIME and Shapley values, and learn when each method can be trusted.

AIML-CV-1.title: Computer Vision 1 · From pixels to convolutional networks
AIML-CV-1.summary: Learn how images are stored as pixel and channel numbers, why plain networks struggle with pictures, and how a sliding filter fixes this.

AIML-CV-2.title: Computer Vision 2 · Overfitting and how to fix it
AIML-CV-2.summary: Read training and validation curves to tell underfitting from overfitting, then test interventions such as batch normalization and see which ones help.

AIML-CV-3.title: Computer Vision 3 · Transfer learning with pretrained CNNs
AIML-CV-3.summary: Adapt a CNN pretrained on millions of images to a small landmark dataset, comparing feature extraction with fine-tuning.

AIML-CV-4.title: Computer Vision 4 · Image similarity and embeddings
AIML-CV-4.summary: Understand why pixel matching fails, turn images into embedding vectors from a pretrained CNN, and compare them with Euclidean and cosine distance.

AIML-CV-5.title: Computer Vision 5 · Visual search with ResNet-50 embeddings
AIML-CV-5.summary: Build a visual search system on Caltech-101: extract ResNet-50 embeddings, run k-nearest-neighbour retrieval, and measure results fairly.

DSML-CV-1.title: Computer Vision 1 · Why CNNs suit images
DSML-CV-1.summary: See what a computer actually receives from an image, why vision is hard, and why convolutional networks are the right tool for image data.

DSML-CV-2.title: Computer Vision 2 · Fighting overfitting step by step
DSML-CV-2.summary: Starting from a CNN that overfits, add one remedy at a time, load image data, and measure what each change buys on validation accuracy.

DSML-CV-3.title: Computer Vision 3 · Building a CNN from scratch
DSML-CV-3.summary: Implement convolution, pooling and dense layers with plain tensor operations, then trace the forward and backward passes on MNIST digits.

DSML-CV-4.title: Computer Vision 4 · Pretrained models and top-k accuracy
DSML-CV-4.summary: Use PyTorch's built-in layers and ImageNet-pretrained models such as AlexNet on a landmark dataset, choosing metrics and preprocessing carefully.

DSML-CV-5.title: Computer Vision 5 · Embeddings and nearest neighbours
DSML-CV-5.summary: Compare Inception and ResNet, measure image similarity, and build nearest-neighbour search on Caltech-101 embeddings, then speed it up with PCA.

DSML-CV-6.title: Computer Vision 6 · Chest X-ray pneumonia classifier
DSML-CV-6.summary: Build a medical imaging pipeline that handles class imbalance and patient-level splits, fine-tunes MobileNetV2, and picks a safe decision threshold.

DSML-CV-7.title: Computer Vision 7 · Object localisation and IoU
DSML-CV-7.summary: Build a single-object localiser with a frozen ResNet-50 and two heads, score boxes with intersection over union, then meet sliding windows and R-CNN.

DSML-CV-8.title: Computer Vision 8 · Single-stage detectors: SSD and YOLO
DSML-CV-8.summary: Learn how SSD and YOLO predict boxes and classes in one pass, decode a pretrained YOLOv5 by hand, and test it under poor conditions.

DSML-CV-9.title: Computer Vision 9 · Image segmentation with U-Net
DSML-CV-9.summary: Label every pixel in a synthetic portrait dataset, train FCN-8 and U-Net with Dice and IoU metrics, and see where Mask R-CNN fits.

DSML-CV-10.title: Computer Vision 10 · Siamese networks for verification
DSML-CV-10.summary: Verify signatures against a single sample with a Siamese network trained using contrastive and triplet loss on the BHSig260 dataset.

DSML-CV-11.title: Computer Vision 11 · Building a GAN for face generation
DSML-CV-11.summary: Build a small generative adversarial network in PyTorch where a generator and discriminator train against each other, then read its training curves.

NumPy-1.title: NumPy 1 · Storing and accessing data
NumPy-1.summary: Move from Python lists to NumPy arrays, creating arrays, checking shape and dtype, and indexing and slicing 1D and 2D marksheets.

NumPy-2.title: NumPy 2 · Vectorised analysis, masks and sorting
NumPy-2.summary: Summarise, filter and sort whole arrays without loops, using axis-based aggregates, boolean masks, broadcasting, np.where and np.select.

NumPy-3.title: NumPy 3 · Copies, views, stacking and matrix multiply
NumPy-3.summary: Avoid silent copy-versus-view bugs, combine and split arrays, run matrix multiplication for weighted scores, and compare NumPy with Pandas.

DAV-1.title: DAV 1 · NumPy arrays, indexing and reshaping
DAV-1.summary: Explore NumPy arrays through interactive simulations: list versus array, arange, dtype conversion, indexing, slicing, reshape and transpose.

DAV---1-Numpy-2.title: DAV 1 · NumPy masks, sorting and broadcasting
DAV---1-Numpy-2.summary: Practise aggregate functions, boolean masking, logical operators, sorting and broadcasting through interactive simulations in 1D and 2D.

DSML-Lin-Alg-1.title: Linear Algebra 1 · Lines, halfspaces and classification
DSML-Lin-Alg-1.summary: See how classification means splitting space in half, and learn features, labels, slope-intercept form and halfspaces as the basis of ML models.

DSML-Lin-Alg-2.title: Linear Algebra 2 · Vectors, norms and dot products
DSML-Lin-Alg-2.summary: Build the vector toolkit behind linear models: magnitude, Euclidean and Manhattan distance, dot products, angles, unit vectors and projections.

DSML-Lin-Alg-3.title: Linear Algebra 3 · Distances from lines and points
DSML-Lin-Alg-3.summary: Prove that a weight vector is perpendicular to its line, then compute how far the origin and any point sit from a decision boundary.

DSML-Lin-Alg-4.title: Linear Algebra 4 · Loss and the perceptron rule
DSML-Lin-Alg-4.summary: Turn which-side-of-the-line into a loss function, fix the sign problem, and learn the perceptron update rule and its non-linear limits.

DSML-Lin-Alg-5.title: Linear Algebra 5 · Worked problems on vectors
DSML-Lin-Alg-5.summary: Solve five worked problems covering projection, orthogonality, angles between unit vectors, parallel-line distance and perceptron updates.

DSML-optmz-1.title: Optimisation 1 · Classifiers, loss and limits
DSML-optmz-1.summary: Learn why machine learning needs calculus: brute-force line search, loss functions, and the functions and limits behind gradient descent.

DSML-optmz-2.title: Optimisation 2 · Derivatives and critical points
DSML-optmz-2.summary: Build derivatives from secants to tangents, apply the differentiation rules, and use the second-derivative test to classify critical points.

DSML-optmz-3.title: Optimisation 3 · Partial derivatives and gradients
DSML-optmz-3.summary: Compute partial derivatives and gradient vectors for multivariable functions, then write the gradient descent update for n variables.

DSML-optmz-4.title: Optimisation 4 · Gradient descent code and Lagrange
DSML-optmz-4.summary: Code gradient descent from scratch, then apply constrained optimisation with Lagrange multipliers to the classifier's loss.

DSML-optmz-5.title: Optimisation 5 · Gradient variants and PCA
DSML-optmz-5.summary: Compare faster gradient descent variants, then learn how PCA uses eigenvectors to rotate axes toward maximum variance and reduce dimensions.

DSML-Pandas-1.title: Pandas 1 · Introduction to Pandas and DataFrames
DSML-Pandas-1.summary: Load data into a DataFrame, inspect its structure, select and rename columns, and filter rows with boolean masks and loc/iloc.

DSML-Pandas-2.title: Pandas 2 · Core DataFrame operations
DSML-Pandas-2.summary: Remove duplicates, slice with loc and iloc, compute aggregates and ratios, sort, and combine tables with concat and merge joins.

DSML-Pandas-3.title: Pandas 3 · groupby, apply and multi-index
DSML-Pandas-3.summary: Group, filter and aggregate rows with groupby, run apply() along both axes, and work with multi-index data on a movie dataset.

DSML-Pandas-4.title: Pandas 4 · Reshaping and cleaning data
DSML-Pandas-4.summary: Reshape wide and long tables with melt and pivot, bin values with pd.cut, and handle None and NaN with isna, dropna and fillna.

DSML-Pandas-5.title: Pandas 5 · Data visualization with Matplotlib
DSML-Pandas-5.summary: Plot univariate and bivariate data in Python: countplots, histograms, KDE and box plots, then scatter and line charts, mapped to Tableau.

SQL.title: SQL 1 · Databases, DBMS and keys
SQL.summary: Understand what a database is, how a DBMS differs from Excel and a data warehouse, and the types of keys, through interactive simulations.

Class2_SQL.title: SQL 2 · Keys, data types and first queries
Class2_SQL.summary: Tell primary, unique, foreign, candidate and composite keys apart, learn SQL data types, and write first queries on Zomato data.

SQL-7.title: SQL 7 · CASE, IF() and conditional aggregation
SQL-7.summary: Turn column values into labels with CASE and IF(), then combine them with conditional COUNT and SUM for pivot-style reports in one query.

SQL-8.title: SQL 8 · JOINs 1: relationships and INNER JOIN
SQL-8.summary: Model one-to-one, one-to-many and many-to-many relationships, then combine tables with INNER JOIN, table aliases and ON clauses.

MySQL---BigQuery-data-interconverter.title: MySQL to BigQuery converter
MySQL---BigQuery-data-interconverter.summary: Convert CSV ZIP exports between MySQL and BigQuery formats in your browser. The page says files are not uploaded anywhere.

Excel-1.title: Excel 1 · Data cleanup and structure
Excel-1.summary: Clean a messy export in Google Sheets: remove duplicates, trim text, handle blanks, fix dates and sort without scrambling rows.

Excel-2.title: Excel 2 · Core formulas
Excel-2.summary: Reference cells, join text, and build IF, IFS, AND/OR, SUMIFS and COUNTIFS logic on a live sales dataset.

Excel-3.title: Excel 3 · Lookups and reporting
Excel-3.summary: Retrieve data across sheets with VLOOKUP, IFERROR, INDEX and MATCH, XLOOKUP, UNIQUE, FILTER and ARRAYFORMULA.

Excel-4.title: Excel 4 · Pivot tables and a mini dashboard
Excel-4.summary: Summarise the Global Superstore data with pivot tables, calculated fields, slicers and a small dashboard, then record a simple macro.

Tableau-1.title: Tableau 1 · Viz fundamentals and KPIs
Tableau-1.summary: Connect to data, pivot wide tables to tall, separate dimensions from measures, and build first charts with live or extract connections.

Tableau-2.title: Tableau 2 · Filters, sets and calculations
Tableau-2.summary: Control which rows reach a chart with sets, parameters and filter order, then write row-level and aggregate calculated fields.

Tableau-3.title: Tableau 3 · Level of detail
Tableau-3.summary: Understand data granularity, then write FIXED, INCLUDE and EXCLUDE expressions to compute totals and averages at a chosen level of detail.

Tableau-4.title: Tableau 4 · Table calculations and analytics
Tableau-4.summary: Compute percent of total, rank and running totals on a finished view, then add tooltips, reference lines and trend lines.

Tableau-5.title: Tableau 5 · Joins, relationships and blends
Tableau-5.summary: Combine multiple data sources with joins, relationships, unions and blends, and avoid row duplication in joined tables.

Tableau-6.title: Tableau 6 · Dashboard creation
Tableau-6.summary: Build an interactive dashboard: lay out containers, add filter, parameter and set actions, and arrange findings into a story.

DSML-2026.title: SQL Advanced · Indexing, partitioning and functions
DSML-2026.summary: Speed up queries with indexing and partitioning, and use advanced SQL functions on larger tables.

DSML-PA-1.title: Product Analytics 1 · Product strategy and business acumen
DSML-PA-1.summary: Structure product-case answers with the Clarify, Plan, Conclude spine and frameworks such as CRIED and TROPiCS.

DSML-PA-2.title: Product Analytics 2 · Product metrics I
DSML-PA-2.summary: Separate vanity from actionable metrics, pick a North Star metric, and arrange primary and supporting metrics into a hierarchy.

DSML-PA-3.title: Product Analytics 3 · Product metrics II
DSML-PA-3.summary: Run the five-step framework end to end on PureFit and Indian Bank cases, choosing funnel-stage, revenue and adoption metrics.

DSML-PA-4.title: Product Analytics 4 · Root cause analysis
DSML-PA-4.summary: Diagnose a metric drop by building a user-journey funnel, stating assumptions, and backtracking through clickstream data to one cause.

DSML-PA-5.title: Product Analytics 5 · Root cause analysis case study
DSML-PA-5.summary: Use Python on 6,745 Uber requests to find when and where cabs vanish, engineer time-slot features and name the mechanism.

DSML-PA-6.title: Product Analytics 6 · Guesstimates I
DSML-PA-6.summary: Estimate a number with no dataset by clarifying the problem, breaking it into segments and calculating from stated assumptions.

DSML-PA-7.title: Product Analytics 7 · Guesstimates II case study
DSML-PA-7.summary: Estimate Google AdSense revenue live with a six-step framework and an estimation tree, then sanity-check and correct the answer.

DSML-PA-8.title: Product Analytics 8 · CRM analytics and RFM segmentation
DSML-PA-8.summary: Score customers on recency, frequency and monetary value in Google Sheets, then turn the RFM segments into a marketing strategy.

DSML-PA-9.title: Product Analytics 9 · Customer segmentation in BigQuery
DSML-PA-9.summary: Build the RFM pipeline in BigQuery SQL with quintile boundaries and 1-to-5 scores, so segments refresh at production scale.

DSML-PA-10.title: Product Analytics 10 · A/B testing and launch decisions
DSML-PA-10.summary: Design an A/B test with hypotheses, p-values, sample size and duration, avoid common pitfalls, and make a launch recommendation.

DSML-PA-11.title: Product Analytics 11 · Applied case study: Amazon Now
DSML-PA-11.summary: Apply the module's frameworks end to end to Amazon Now in the festive sale: define success metrics with AAAERR and guardrails.

DSML-PA-12.title: Product Analytics 12 · Applied case study: conversion drop
DSML-PA-12.summary: Investigate a sudden conversion drop with CRIED and TROPiCS, localise it in the funnel by hour, and find the root cause.
